cheese grater in Latin

cheese grater

rādula, rādulae f.

Ancient LatinMedieval & RenaissanceDraft
  • rādula, rādulae f. — scraper, grater classical (Col. 12.18.5) The lexicon’s word for a kitchen grater; Morgan–Owens records the kitchen use.
  • tyrocnēstis, tyrocnēstis f. — cheese grater Renaissance also used (M-O s.v. grater: cheese-grater, from Vives, 1540) A Renaissance coinage from Greek.

See also: whisk.
